newsitem.title: FRANCE: French paedophile ring included maths teacher.
newsitem.headline: French paedophile ring included maths teacher.

text.p: A paedophile ring jailed in France included a mathematics teacher, officials said on Wednesday.
Daniel Pouquet-Barthez, who teaches at an engineering college in Rennes in the north-west, was among six men sentenced on Tuesday for up to five years.
They were arrested after police, acting on a tip-off from a photographic shop asked to develop one of their films, uncovered hundreds of photographs and several videos featuring girls aged under 15.
Jean-Patrick Lanez, a disabled man said to be the ring leader, was jailed for five years for distributing child pornography, sexual abuse and corruption of minors.
Christophe Grisard, an artisan from Vendee, western France, was sentenced to two years. The others received lesser sentences.
France is drafting new laws to crack down on paedophiles after shock over the sexual abuse and murder of four children in neighbouring Belgium.
